title: multi run coord: the refused code agent asks the claim's holder the dup_of event names, whichever code agent wins the claim
goal: in multi run coord the asking agent is the code agent a shared store refused and the asked agent is the dup_of event's held_by, not a fixed code-2 to code-1, so the answer never comes from an agent that did no work (reviewer of SP-p46hofrg on ST-kx6qdtkv g1 and g2, operator answer of g2 changed to this)

run:
import glob, json, os, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, tempfile
D = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rv-', dir=os.environ.get('TMPDIR', '/tmp'))
b = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'multi', *a, '--dir', D], capture_output=True, text=True)
b('run', 'coord', '--replay', '--coord', 'shared')
d = [json.loads(f) for s in glob.glob(D + '/coord/**/coord.sqlite', recursive=True) for k, f in sqlite3.connect(s).execute('SELECT kind, fields FROM events') if k == 'dup_of']
t = open(D + '/results.jsonl', encoding='utf-8').read()
b('remove')
assert d, 'no refused claim'
held, asker = d[0]['held_by'], d[0]['holder']
assert ('ask ' + held.replace('multi-', '')) in t or ('ask ' + held) in t, ('the ask does not go to the holder the dup_of event names', held, asker)
